router.name: Customer Intake
router.purpose: Front door of the Nova assistant: classifies each customer request (bill, services, SIM or port-out, offers, account recovery) and routes it to the right specialist agent.

billing_agent.name: Billing Agent
billing_agent.purpose: Explains statements and applies goodwill or outage credits up to $50. Larger credits go to a billing supervisor.

provisioning_agent.name: Provisioning Agent
provisioning_agent.purpose: Adds and changes services, refunds charges for services billed after deactivation, and sets call forwarding. Third-party charges only with the customer's explicit consent.
provisioning_agent.escalation: Refunds for deactivated services → billing-correction desk

sim_porting_agent.name: SIM & Porting Agent
sim_porting_agent.purpose: Moves a number to a new SIM after secure authentication, and releases numbers to other carriers whose porting agent presents a passport TeleNova recognises. Acts across the trust boundary with other carriers, so it carries an agent passport.
sim_porting_agent.escalation: Takeover risk or unrecognised carrier → fraud desk

retention_agent.name: Retention Agent
retention_agent.purpose: Makes save offers to customers likely to leave, from the approved offer catalogue. Offers must not be keyed on protected or proxy attributes such as postcode.

account_recovery.name: Account Recovery
account_recovery.purpose: Opens an account-recovery case when a customer reports a SIM swap or port-out they didn't request, freezes the line and convenes the Account Recovery Board.

coordinator.name: Recovery Board Coordinator
coordinator.purpose: Polls the four board reviewers, tallies their votes and escalates an unresolved split to a human.

recovery_board.name: Account Recovery Board
recovery_board.purpose: The board's escalation channel: hands a deadlocked recovery decision to a human with the votes and the precedence rule.

fraud_reviewer.name: Fraud Reviewer
fraud_reviewer.purpose: Weighs account-takeover signals on the disputed port-out and votes to UPHOLD or OVERTURN the freeze. Advisory only.

retention_reviewer.name: Retention Reviewer
retention_reviewer.purpose: Weighs the cost of losing a long-tenure customer while their line is frozen and votes UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

care_reviewer.name: Customer Care Reviewer
care_reviewer.purpose: Weighs the customer being left without service and locked out of 2FA, and votes UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

compliance_reviewer.name: Compliance Reviewer
compliance_reviewer.purpose: Weighs FCC SIM-swap and port-out obligations (secure authentication, customer notice) and votes UPHOLD or OVERTURN. Advisory only.

fallback.name: Help Desk
fallback.purpose: Answers requests no specialist matches. Takes no actions and reads no account data.
